title: Gaussian elimination work estimate
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite set with decidable equality and an encoding, and let a CSP instance over the maximum linear predicate template with parameter $r$ be given. Its Gaussian elimination work is the number of constraints times $|V|+1$, plus the work of the cubic $\mathbb F_2$ linear solver backend on the instance's list of linear equation rows.
hypotheses_covered: A CSP instance over the maximum linear predicate template with parameter $r$
caveat: The row translation and the work function of the cubic linear solver backend are not defined in the supplied context.
